sections.title: Movers in Playa Vista, Scheduled Around Your Building
sections.content: Playa Vista stretches from the Ballona Wetlands to the Westchester Bluffs, and condo, loft and apartment buildings here may run moves through a management office. We plan the crew around the elevator reservation and move window your building assigns, and stairs, long carries and extra stops are included in the hourly rate. What you get when you book SOS Moving Licensed and covered: CPUC licensed, with USDOT 3398018, MC 1153871 and CAL-T0192140, plus full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Rated by real customers: 4.9 on Google from 1,007 reviews. Hourly, with fees spelled out: From $119/hr for two movers and a truck Monday–Thursday (cash rate), $135/hr Friday–Sunday, a $30 gas fee, and a $50 deposit that goes toward your total. Send us your building's move rules and your floor number, and we'll set the arrival time to match your elevator slot.

sections.title: Packing Services for Playa Vista Condos and Lofts
sections.content: When your building hands you a fixed elevator slot, the boxes should be taped and labeled before it opens. With our packing services, the crew wraps furniture, boxes each room and stages everything near the door, so your reserved time goes to loading. What packing day covers Materials on the truck: Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and wardrobe boxes are included in the hourly rate, so closets go straight from the rod into a box. Glass, art and screens: Mirrors, glass tabletops and framed pieces get extra padding, and we unmount wall TVs and wrap them for the ride. Unpacked at the other end: We set furniture where you want it and help unpack, so you're not digging through boxes in the new place. Moving art, antiques or designer furniture? Ask about our white glove movers.

sections.title: Moves Within Playa Vista and Across the Westside
sections.content: Whether you're trading a Playa Vista apartment for a house in Culver City or moving into a townhome near Runway Playa Vista, our apartment movers charge the same hourly rate for walk-ups, elevator buildings and long hallways from the loading area. Included at the hourly rate Stairs and long carries: No surcharge for flights of stairs or for the walk between the truck and your front door. Furniture, start to finish: Disassembly, reassembly, TV unmounting and placement in each room are part of the job. More than one stop: Picking up from a storage unit or dropping pieces at a second address stays on the same hourly bill. Double Drive Time applies under CPUC rules on longer local moves; if you're leaving the LA area, our long-distance movers take it from there.

sections.title: Long-Distance Moves Out of Playa Vista
sections.content: Relocating to another state or north to the Bay Area? We pack your Playa Vista home, load during your building's move window, and pick up the I-405 at Jefferson Boulevard with everything wrapped for the full trip. How we handle the long haul Packed for the distance: Furniture is blanket-wrapped and shrink-wrapped, and boxes are labeled by room so unloading goes in order. Storage if dates don't line up: If your new lease or closing isn't ready yet, we can hold your belongings in storage until it is. Registered for interstate work: USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871 are the federal registrations that let us move you across state lines. Only going as far as Culver City or Westchester? Book local moving instead of a long-distance move.

sections.title: Office Moves in Silicon Beach
sections.content: From creative offices along Jefferson Boulevard to Google's space in the former Spruce Goose hangar, Playa Vista is a Silicon Beach business hub, and our commercial movers relocate desks, files and IT equipment on the schedule your building sets. Some office buildings here keep tenant moves out of weekday business hours, so we book those moves on a Saturday or Sunday.

faq.question: Does my Playa Vista building need anything from the movers?
faq.answer: Often, yes. Condo and apartment buildings may ask residents to reserve the elevator, stick to a set move window and show proof of insurance for the moving company, and some also take a refundable deposit. Send us your building's move rules when you book, and we'll get the insurance certificate to management before move day.

faq.question: Can you move our Silicon Beach office on a weekend?
faq.answer: Yes. Some Playa Vista office buildings, including i|o at Playa Vista on Millennium Drive, only allow tenant moves outside weekday business hours or on weekends, and they want the mover's certificate of insurance on file first. We work Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM, so those office moves usually go on a Saturday or Sunday.

faq.question: What will I pay for a Playa Vista apartment or condo move?
faq.answer: Our rate starts at $119/hr for two movers and a truck on Monday–Thursday (cash rate) and $135/hr Friday–Sunday, plus a $30 gas fee; the $50 deposit is applied toward your total. Stairs, long carries from a loading area and multiple stops are included. A piano adds $200, and items heavier than 300 lbs add $150.

faq.question: Can you do a same-day move in Playa Vista?
faq.answer: Yes, when a crew is free. Call 909-443-0004 between 8AM and 6PM, any day of the week. If your building requires an elevator reservation or an insurance certificate, confirm that management can clear the move for the same day before we send the truck.
